title: Tessera: Unlocking Heterogeneous GPUs through Kernel-Granularity Disaggregation
abstract: arXiv:2604.10180v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Disaggregation maps parts of an AI workload to different types of GPUs, offering a path to utilize modern heterogeneous GPU clusters. However, existing solutions operate at a coarse granularity and are tightly coupled to specific model architectures, leaving much room for performance improvement. This paper presents Tessera, the first kernel disaggregation system to improve performance and cost efficiency on heterogeneous GPUs for large model inference. Our key insight is that kernels within a single application exhibit diverse resource demands, making them the most suitable granularity for aligning computation with hardware capabilities. Tessera integrates offline analysis with online adaptation by extracting precise inter-kernel dependencies from PTX to ensure correctness, overlapping communication with computation through a pipelined execution model, and employing workload-aware scheduling with lightweight runtime adaptation

translated_title: Tessera：通过内核粒度解耦释放异构GPU的潜力
translated_abstract: 解耦技术将AI工作负载的不同部分映射到不同类型的GPU上，为利用现代异构GPU集群提供了一条途径。然而，现有解决方案在较粗的粒度上运行，并且与特定模型架构紧密耦合，在性能提升方面仍有很大空间。本文提出了Tessera，这是首个通过内核解耦来提升异构GPU上大模型推理性能和成本效率的系统。我们的关键洞察是：单个应用内的各个内核具有多样化的资源需求，使其成为将计算与硬件能力对齐的最合适粒度。Tessera将离线分析与在线自适应相结合：通过从PTX中提取精确的内核间依赖关系来确保正确性，通过流水线执行模型实现通信与计算的重叠，并采用工作负载感知调度与轻量级运行时自适应。
tldr: Tessera是首个内核粒度的异构GPU解耦系统，通过从PTX提取内核间依赖、流水线化通信与计算重叠以及工作负载感知调度，显著提升大模型推理在异构GPU集群上的性能与成本效率。
en_tdlr: Tessera is the first kernel-granularity disaggregation system that improves performance and cost efficiency of large model inference on heterogeneous GPUs by extracting inter-kernel dependencies from PTX, overlapping communication with computation via pipelined execution, and employing workload-aware scheduling with lightweight runtime adaptation.
